pattern: に関わらず（にかかわらず）
purpose: State that a condition does not affect the outcome.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
N / paired alternatives + にかかわらず
Anyone may participate regardless of age.
We will hold it indoors whether it rains or not.
Everyone works on the same task regardless of preference.
formation: N / paired alternatives + にかかわらず
restrictions: Means regardless of; no particular result is predicted by the condition.
mistake: Distinguish にもかかわらず, which means despite a fact.
